| 指标 | 值 |
|------|-----|
| mean_accuracy | 80.77% |
| mean_bcs | 0.557 |
| Δ_BCS (low−high) | −3.92pp, CI [−7.79, +0.42] |
| Pearson(BCS, acc) | −0.221, p=0.027 |
| Regression slope | −0.401, CI [−0.684, −0.062] |
